notes.title: Small audio patch
notes.content: Audio should now be properly set when you enter the game.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Fixed various multiplayer menu issues.
Clients in multiplayer should be able to hear the dog barking and owl hooting as they approach.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Fixed Pause and Game over menu controller functionality.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Options and Leaderboard are now accessible from the end of game menu.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Fixed UI issues when restarting a game.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Fixed some of the UI issues in single and multiplayer.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Added new audio which can be turned up or down in the options menu.
Added Options and Leaderboard to in game pause menu.
Dog and Owls now Bark or Hoot when they first see you.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Owls should not bombard players one after the other.
Fixed bug with new stamina boost mechanic.

notes.title: Microscopic Patch
notes.content: Added back something added yesterday that got removed today.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Hitting the dog or owls with a nut(s) will cause them to chase you.
Owls have had health reduced.
Owls awareness and speed turned down slightly.
Owls should walk/fly properly now instead of sliding.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Fixed bugs with new stamina feature.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Players are now rewarded for with 400% stamina boost for 30s when exploding the dog or owls.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Limited leaderboard to single player scores only.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Increased Owl awareness.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Spawn points are now as originally intended.
Added numbers that correspond with Dog remaining health.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Characters should no longer spawn on top of each other.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Fixed bug with not being able to revive in multiplayer on the client side

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Most multiplayer scoreboard issues resolved.
Still a few bugs involving other stuff to fix, I am working on them.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Fixed issues with tree score numbers.
Multiplayer scoring is non functional atm.
Leaderboard has been reset due to scoring changes.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Finished tree score pop up text

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Fixed bug with dog interaction introduced in previous patch.
Added floating tree score text (WIP)
Added Score to top left corner of screen.

notes.title: Menu fixes
notes.content: Fixed button and menu alignment.

notes.title: Small bug
notes.content: Fixed small bug with Dog not respawning after death.
